name: Report to Kadrak
label: Quest

intro: This military dispatch directs Horde warriors from Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains to Kadrak's watch post on the border of the northern Barrens. It marks the transition from defending the crags to reinforcing the Horde's contentious military campaign inside Ashenvale. By reporting to Kadrak, soldiers are marshaled to support forward encampments like Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
